record.body:
## Description

In ~/adaptive-artifacts, add a pure formatter from rendered view markdown to terminal text: drop the derived-view banner and _(id: ...)_ suffixes, bold headings unless colour is off (NO_COLOR set or stdout not a tty), truncate each line to a given width with an ellipsis, and print an empty-state line when the view has no records.

payload.title: Format a rendered view for the terminal

record.subject: terminal-view-format
